chunks: Or do they think We do not hear their secrecies and stealthy consultations? In fact, Our messengers who attend them record everything.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God hearing our secret thoughts?
ai.summary: In Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse refutes the polytheists' arrogance by affirming that God’s knowledge encompasses not just public acts but also the most intimate whispers (najwah). Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight the plural 'Rusuluna' (Our Messengers) as referring to the recording angels who meticulously document these secrets, serving as a precursor to the Day of Judgment where no hidden thought will remain concealed.
